shape.text: 🟢 Each Chrome window is now a **space**: *Chrome*, *Chrome 2*… (another profile: *Chrome · its name*). Its tabs stay asleep until you open them. Switch with **⌃1–9**, **⌃⌥← →** or the icons at the foot of the sidebar.
🟢 Pinned tabs are **Favourites**: the squares at the top of the sidebar. One set, the same in every space, and they never tidy themselves away.
🟢 Tab groups are **folders** with the same names, in the kept part of the sidebar, above the line. Drag a tab into one to keep it too.
🟡 Every other open tab is in **Today**, under *New Tab*. A Today tab you haven’t looked at for a day closes itself. **Save** the ones you want to keep (see below).

ℹ️ There’s no bookmarks bar. Your bar’s sites join the top level of the **Bookmarks** list (the books button at the foot of the sidebar); Chrome’s *Other* and *Mobile* become folders. **⌘K** finds them too; **⇧⌘B** adds one.
🟢 Passwords are in your Mac’s **keychain**. Click a sign-in field and Copper offers them; it never fills on its own. **⌥⌘L** lists them. Bitwarden and 1Password plug in at *Settings › Passwords*.

🟡 Web Store extensions you brought install in the background, one at a time. They run on WebKit’s engine (macOS 15.4 or later), so a few may not work. Manage them from the puzzle button at the foot of the sidebar.
🟢 History you brought over shows under **⌘Y**, and **⌘T** suggests from it as you type. Moving in again merges it, so nothing doubles up.

shape.title: Tabs · above the line you keep, below it tidies itself

shape.text: 🟢 **Favourites**: your Chrome pinned tabs. The same squares in every space. Never closed for you.
🟢 **Above the line**: the tabs you keep, and your tab groups as folders. Nothing up here closes on its own.
ℹ️ **The line** and *New Tab* split what you keep from what you’re just looking at.
🟡 **Below the line** is Today, newest first. A tab you haven’t looked at for **24 hours** closes itself.
ℹ️ **The foot**: Bookmarks, Extensions and Canvases buttons, then your spaces, and **+** for a new space.
🟢 **Keep one**: drag it up above the line, or right-click it › *Save*. Drag it back down, or *Unsave*, to let it go.
🟢 **Lost one?** It closed the normal way, so **⇧⌘T** brings it back (the last 12 you closed).
ℹ️ Never tidied: the tab you’re on, a canvas, or a tab showing in another window.
🟡 **⇧⌘K** clears the loose Today tabs in this space at once. **⌘Z** within six seconds brings them back.
ℹ️ Not for you? *Settings › Tabs › Archive Today after*: 12h, 24h, 48h or Never.

shape.title: Keys · the ones a Chrome hand reaches for

shape.text: 🟢 **Ads and trackers** are blocked before the page loads. If a site breaks, switch off *Block on <site>* in *Settings › Privacy*.
🟢 **Tabs sleep** after half an hour away and wake where you left them. Pinned tabs, sound, calls and typing stay awake.
🟢 **⇧⌘H** hides a cookie banner or popup on a site for good. **⇧⌘P** floats a video above everything.
ℹ️ **⇧⌘N** is a private tab: nothing is kept once it closes, and extensions don’t run in it.
👤 **⌘E** opens the agent beside the page. It needs a model first: *Settings › Intelligence*. **⌥⌘E** closes every pane.
ℹ️ This is a **canvas**. **⌃⇧E** makes a new one, **⇧⌘O** opens your Personal one, and the canvas button at the sidebar’s foot lists them all.
ℹ️ **⇧⌘D** is Split View: two tabs side by side in one window. **⌘N** still opens a new window.
ℹ️ **⌘,** opens Settings. The search field at the top of its sidebar finds any switch by name.
